criteria.text: Live `message.part.delta` for current session updates the addressed part/field in memory and becomes visible before `session.idle`; unknown/mismatched session/part events do not corrupt state.
criteria.reason: Reducer and real provider-context tests observe pre-idle text and reject mismatched session, part, and field updates.

criteria.text: `message.part.updated` upserts authoritative part snapshots; `message.updated` upserts metadata while retaining existing parts unless event explicitly supplies them.
criteria.reason: Focused reducer assertions cover authoritative part upsert and metadata-only message updates.

criteria.text: Delta/updated state commits are coalesced into a bounded 75ms window (leading or max-wait behavior acceptable if deterministic). Continuous 100-delta burst cannot starve commits. Avoid a React commit per delta.
criteria.reason: A fixed-from-first-event 75ms batch publishes a 100-delta burst in one measured React transcript commit.

criteria.text: Existing `session.idle` refresh remains authoritative and deep-equal convergence succeeds when 20% of synthetic delta events are intentionally withheld/out of order as supported; define explicit handling for duplicate/out-of-order snapshots/deltas.
criteria.reason: Provider test withholds/reorders synthetic stream input at reducer level and verifies session.idle GET replacement deep-equals the authoritative transcript.

criteria.text: During a 100-delta burst, visible transcript advances before idle and pre-idle messages GET count is 0. Baseline on parent should show no pre-idle in-memory transcript advancement / eventual refetch behavior. Record identical baseline/post measurements: time/event-count to first visible text, React state commit count, messages GET count pre-idle, final reconciliation equality.
criteria.reason: Identical baseline/post provider protocol measured none/104ms to visible text, 0/1 pre-idle commits, 1/0 pre-idle message GETs, and true/true final reconciliation.

criteria.text: Preserve auto-scroll behaviors (8/8), current message merge/fetch generation safety, pending interactions, status handling, and offline/reconnect semantics.
criteria.reason: Auto-scroll passed 8/8; combined chat passed 75/75; fetch-generation/event transport passed 11/11; offline/reconnect passed 8/8.

criteria.text: Run focused reducer/provider/performance tests, combined changed chat tests, lint, typecheck, diff check, full mobile Jest, and the Mobile CI foundation gate. Use sandbox live-ish SSE/fake-server where possible without real provider credentials.
criteria.reason: Final verification ran focused and combined chat suites, fake-server, lint, typecheck, full mobile Jest with four exact parent-red issue-1387 failures, and the complete Mobile CI foundation/browser gate.

criteria.text: Exact production SDK `message.part.delta` payloads without a unique event ID must not collapse by messageID or partID; multiple same-message deltas all reach the reducer.
criteria.reason: Exact SDK-shape anonymous same-message deltas all return null stable identity and remain in the recovery stream.

criteria.text: Recovery events with truly stable explicit IDs and unrelated event types with stable recovery identities retain duplicate suppression.
criteria.reason: Explicit delta event IDs and unrelated message removal fallback identities still suppress duplicates.

criteria.text: At provider level, 20% withheld and reverse-ordered supported anonymous deltas advance before idle and then deep-equal the authoritative transcript after session.idle.
criteria.reason: Provider delivers 80 reverse-ordered anonymous deltas after withholding 20%, then session.idle deep-equals the authoritative 100-character message record.

criteria.text: Queued streaming events remain keyed to their addressed session when the current session switches.
criteria.reason: Provider switches sessions while a delta batch is queued, keeps the second session unchanged, and retains the addressed first-session preview.

criteria.text: Unmount cancels queued transcript batches so no delayed state publication occurs.
criteria.reason: Unmount before the 75ms deadline cancels the queued batch and produces zero transcript commits.
